evidence: PenguinArcade: players get an anonymous Supabase guest identity created automatically — no username, email, or password is ever collected.
supabase/migrations/20260723_waddleton_foundation.sql: waddleton_profiles stores a display name and a profile state JSON only; there is no credential column.
PenguinArcade client: a grep for gtag, GTM, PostHog, Plausible, Mixpanel, Sentry, Amplitude, and Firebase returns no third-party analytics or telemetry SDK.

The only stored per-network-address data is a guest-signup rate-limit list of timestamps in the Cloudflare Durable Object (worker/src/index.mjs allowGuestSignup), which ages out and is disclosed on the privacy page.
js/economy.js: adAvailable() and watchAd() both return false unconditionally — no rewarded-ad path is reachable.
No advertising SDK is present in the client. The 'no ads' claim is about ADVERTISING only and is still exactly true.

PURCHASES ARE NOW REAL, and the copy on this site was corrected to match: the WaddletonStore native bridge (StoreKit 2 on iOS, Play Billing on Android) sells Goldfish consumables and the auto-renewing Waddleton Club subscription in the mobile app. js/storefront.js still reports 'store-unavailable' in the BROWSER build, which is why the web version remains purchase-free. Everything sold is cosmetic; no purchase affects a score or a leaderboard.
